verification.fullExtension: Existing Chrome clipboard, storage, directory I/O, reload and retained UI gates remain mandatory before packaging.
verification.projectTrash: Separate real-extension gate covers deletion, restore, expiry and inbox.

verification.webStage: Experimental independent Chrome popup per logical workspace tab, positioned at the workspace frame. Switching retains document state; inactive windows minimize. verification.mediaTransfer: Image import from an explicitly authorized editable page copy is tested; live provider media is not claimed.
